resources.string: No provider configured. Cloud Pinyin will not send any request.
This provider is already in the list.
Fall back to the next provider on failure

Off by default. When enabled, providers are tried in list order until one returns a candidate. This adds latency, may send the same pinyin to several third parties, and different providers may return different candidates.
These third-party endpoints have no official SLA and may stop working at any time. Pinyin text is sent only to the providers in the list when a query is made.
